data.description: Discovered while attesting 4ca2 AC5 (structured-output-baseline run 31003041092). Under the matrix proxy harness (SENTINEL_DIRECTIVE appended to bare production prompts), live marker adoption was 0/20 across anthropic/bedrock/openai: models honored the 'single object, no fence' clause (which improved parse success: anthropic 6->12, bedrock 9->11) but did NOT emit the literal <<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>>/<<<END>>> markers. The E2 compliance fact (16/16 sonnet/haiku on Bedrock) was measured under the REAL schema_directive path (SENTINEL_DIRECTIVE trailing the schema directive), not this bare-prompt append; the proxy under-measures compliance and the 'Then wrap...' lead-in dangles when appended to a bare prompt. The parser's fail-closed NO-DECOY-WIN safety is proven offline and does not depend on live adoption, so this is a reliability improvement, not a defect. Options: strengthen/rephrase SENTINEL_DIRECTIVE for bare-prompt robustness, add a one-shot marker example, or align the matrix 'sentinel' variant with the real schema_directive path. Acceptance: a live measurement shows marker adoption materially >0 on at least anthropic+bedrock without regressing parse-success.
data.title: Raise live sentinel marker-channel adoption by frontier models
